cases.case: a keyword anywhere in the text, any case, is found with its offsets
every keyword counts, in text order, each occurrence
cases.text: ultracode this, then ultrathink, then ultrathink again

cases.case: other thinking phrases are plain text
cases.text: think hard, think harder, be thorough, ultra think

cases.case: a word that merely contains a keyword is not one
a text that starts with a slash is a command, never a keyword carrier
a slash or backslash before or after, a hyphen either side, or a question mark after, makes it a path or a term
cases.text: src/ultrathink and ultrathink/x and a\ultrathink and ultrathink\x and re-ultrathink and ultrathink-x and ultrathink?

cases.case: a full stop ends the sentence unless a word character follows it
cases.text: think. ultrathink. and ultrathink.md and ultrathink.

cases.case: inside quotes, backticks, brackets, braces or parentheses it is quoted, not asked for
a tag quotes only its own angle brackets, so its content counts
text after a closed span still counts
an apostrophe inside a word is no quote, one that opens a word is
a quote span is closed by an apostrophe only when no letter follows it
